params.body:
## Summary

Four things every dealer in the market comparison (Braem, Degroote, Elro Trucks, BAS World) does and this site did not. Builds on the category navigation pull request, because the mobile menu reuses its icons.

- **Sell page in the buyer's words.** The menu item "Aankoop" becomes "Voertuig verkopen" (the four translations existed already). The page shows the three steps above the form and accepts up to six photos instead of one; the controller stores and attaches each of them.
- **Mobile menu.** Below the md breakpoint the navigation was hidden entirely; Voertuig verkopen, Het bedrijf and Contact were only reachable through the footer. A hamburger now opens a panel with the categories and their icons, the other pages, and call and WhatsApp buttons.
- **Richer vehicle cards.** The reference number (which the current site shows and customers quote on the phone) sits top right, and one line under the title gives wheel formula, transmission and body type, the fields the competitors put on their cards or in their titles.
- **Services pages.** Five pages under `/diensten` (tachograph, repairs and maintenance, bodywork and conversion, rental and trade-in, financing) plus an overview, with content from the current site and the company's own directory listings; what Schoutteet still has to confirm is marked as provisional outside production (`App\Site\Services` carries the source per paragraph). The services sit in a header dropdown, the mobile menu, the footer, the home service list and the sitemap, in five languages.

Tests: new feature tests for the card, the header, the sell form with two photos and the services pages; the category test counts one more icon set. Suite: 33 tests, 242 assertions. Checked in a headless browser on the local stock.

## After merge

Deploy; nothing else.
